meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: Claude 会按你指定的时间段（默认最近 7 天）查询飞书会议，找到每场会议的纪要及逐字稿链接，生成结构化汇总报告，列出会议时间、主题、链接；需要写文档时也能生成或追加到飞书云文档。
howto.when: 当用户要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报，或回顾某时期会议时触发；可用“今天/这周/上月”限定范围。

say.text: 把这周的会议纪要整理成一份周报
say.note: 按本周一至今搜索，输出“会议纪要周报”格式报告。

say.text: 帮我回顾一下今天开了哪些会
say.note: 生成“今日会议概览”，列出会议时间、主题、纪要链接。

say.text: 总结上个月的会议纪要
say.note: 按上个月范围查询会议，汇总生成结构化报告。

howto.what_en: Given a period (default: past 7 days), Claude finds Lark meetings, retrieves their notes and transcript links, and returns a structured summary with meeting time, topics, and links. It can also create or append the summary to a Lark doc if asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to sort meeting notes, create a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period; time words like today/this week/last month can set the range.

say_en.text: Compile this week's meeting notes into a weekly report.
say_en.note: Searches Monday-to-now meetings and outputs a weekly report.

say_en.text: Help me review what meetings happened today.
say_en.note: Generates today's overview: time, topics, links.
Queries last month and outputs a structured report.
